events.title: Romanos I Lekapenos is deposed by his sons
events.description: The Byzantine emperor Romanos I Lekapenos, regent and senior co-ruler for Constantine VII since 920, was arrested by two of his sons and forced to abdicate. He lived out his life as a monk.
events.html: The Byzantine emperor Romanos I Lekapenos, regent and senior co-ruler for Constantine VII since 920, was arrested by two of his sons and forced to abdicate. He lived out his life as a monk.

events.title: The Synod of Sutri opens to settle rival claims to the papacy
events.description: The council called by Henry III, king of Germany, opened at Sutri, at the edge of the Duchy of Rome, to deal with rival claimants to the papacy. Henry deposed the rival popes and went on to install reforming German popes.

events.title: Mongol envoys meet Louis IX in Cyprus
events.description: In Cyprus, King Louis IX of France, bound for the Seventh Crusade, received two Mongol envoys bearing a letter from Eljigidei, the Mongol commander in Persia. They proposed that Louis land in Egypt while Eljigidei attacked Baghdad.

events.title: Virginia Company ships sail for America
events.description: The Susan Constant, Godspeed and Discovery left London with about 105 colonists. In May 1607 they founded Jamestown, the first permanent English settlement in North America.

events.title: The United States takes possession of Louisiana
events.description: In a ceremony in New Orleans, France formally handed the Louisiana Territory to the United States. The purchase roughly doubled the country's size and gave it control of the Mississippi.
events.html: In a ceremony in New Orleans, France formally handed the Louisiana Territory to the United States. The purchase roughly doubled the country's size and gave it control of the Mississippi.

events.title: South Carolina secedes from the Union
events.description: A convention in Charleston voted unanimously to leave the United States after Lincoln's election. Six more states followed before his inauguration, forming the Confederacy.
events.html: A convention in Charleston voted unanimously to leave the United States after Lincoln's election. Six more states followed before his inauguration, forming the Confederacy.

events.title: The United States invades Panama
events.description: US forces launched Operation Just Cause to remove Panama's military ruler Manuel Noriega, who was wanted in the US on drug trafficking charges. Noriega surrendered on 3 January 1990.
events.html: US forces launched Operation Just Cause to remove Panama's military ruler Manuel Noriega, who was wanted in the US on drug trafficking charges. Noriega surrendered on 3 January 1990.

events.title: Argentina's president resigns amid riots
events.description: President Fernando de la Rúa resigned and fled the Casa Rosada by helicopter as protests over economic collapse left dozens dead. Days later Argentina declared the largest sovereign default to that date.
